lines.beaver_en: Your presentation's over! How do you feel now?
lines.learner: 아직 떨려. 내가 잘한 건가 싶어.
lines.en: I'm still shaking. I wonder if I did well.
lines.roman: ajik tteollyeo. naega jalhan geonga sipeo.

lines.beaver_en: You must have been really nervous before it started.
lines.en: Yeah, I was so anxious my hands kept shaking.

lines.beaver_en: How was it during the presentation?
lines.en: At first I was excited, but it got harder and harder.

lines.beaver_en: Why was it hard? Did something happen?
lines.en: I messed up while changing slides. It was so embarrassing.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, so that's why your face turned red.
lines.en: Yeah, I was so embarrassed I got stuck.

lines.beaver_en: Still, you made it all the way to the end.
lines.en: Did I? I still feel a bit disappointed.

lines.learner: 한 친구가 나를 안타까워하는 것 같았어.
lines.en: One friend seemed to feel sorry for me.
lines.roman: han chinguga nareul antakkawohaneun geot gatasseo.

lines.beaver_en: They were probably just rooting for you.
lines.learner: 그래도 좀 싫었어. 내가 불쌍해 보였나?
lines.en: I still didn't like it. Did I look pitiful?
lines.roman: geuraedo jom sireosseo. naega bulssanghae boyeonna?

lines.beaver_en: How did you feel after that?
lines.en: Afterward, I almost cried in the bathroom.

lines.beaver_en: And now? Feeling a bit better?
lines.learner: 응, 너한테 말하니까 마음이 편해졌어. 고마워.
lines.en: Yeah, talking to you made me feel better. Thanks.
lines.roman: eung, neohante malhanikka maeumi pyeonhaejeosseo. gomawo.
